parameters.description: revision_id is optional; unset tests the profile's live revision.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: network is the admission target, e.g. binance-testnet.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: mode is the run mode to admit, e.g. TESTNET.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
W5 workspace bootstrap: strategy creation, draft persistence, version
browsing and approval reads.

policyJson.description:
policy_json is the reviewed reviewable-v1 document the operator confirms;
the freeze stores exactly what was reviewed.

proposalJson.description:
proposal_json is a candidate.PolicyProposal document (the extraction
output); the server derives proposal_state from it.

apiKey.description:
api_key is the plaintext provider key (vault removed 2026-10-15); the
fingerprint column is derived server-side and never typed by an operator.

gctrpcLLMActionProposal.description:
LLMActionProposal is one inert configuration draft produced by the
proposeAction tool; the webUI renders it as a confirmation card and the
operator's confirm calls the same governed RPC the manual pages use.

content.description: content is decrypted for display; storage keeps it sealed.

delta.description: delta is one content fragment as it arrived from the provider.

final.description: final carries the completed turn; the last event of a successful stream.

error.description: error carries a stream failure the client must show.

progress.description: progress is a live tool-progress update (e.g. a full-universe screen).

gctrpcLLMCreateStrategyRequest.description:
W5 workspace bootstrap: strategy creation, draft persistence, version
browsing and approval reads.

sourceTime.description: source_time is the data source's own timestamp (asOf), RFC3339.

sha256.description: sha256 is the hash of the exact result bytes the model saw.

found.description: found is false when no pairing has ever been activated.

metricsJson.description: metrics_json is the full metric snapshot (counters, gauges, histograms).

liveUnlocked.description:
live_unlocked is true once the mode is LIVE: the triple gate is what let
the mode land, so the mode itself is the settled proof.

reviewExpireHours.description:
review_expire_hours is the configured expiry window for unhandled REVIEW
decisions (default 12h); the UI derives the expired state from it, so a
tightened window does not leave stale clients lying.

gctrpcLLMGetStatusResponse.description:
LLMGetStatusResponse carries the dashboard core. Fields whose sources await
production adapters (clock drift, oldest data age, running/decisions
counters) are deliberately absent until they can be sourced truthfully.

gctrpcLLMHaltRow.description:
W7-01 halt write side: the three-level stop (SOFT/MARKET/FULL) and its
re-authenticated clear that never auto-resumes anything.

gctrpcLLMNotifyChannel.description:
W7-06 notification channels: Telegram and the generic webhook (Q19). The
surface reports configuration readiness only -- credentials are never
echoed (booleans, not values); editing channels is a configuration act.

gctrpcLLMPositionDelta.description:
W7-02 manual reconciliation: one operator-triggered pass of "local view vs
exchange truth"; a mismatch trips SOFT halt and records the deltas.

revision.description: revision is the newest revision; unset when none exists yet.

apiKeyFingerprint.description: api_key_fingerprint is the server-derived SHA-256 prefix (16 hex).

maxOutputTokens.description: Optional numeric fields use 0 for unset (proto3 scalars).

supersededAt.description: superseded_at is empty while this revision is the live one.

detail.description: detail carries the actual value vs the expectation.

ready.description: ready is true only when every gate passed.

locked.description: locked marks the red-line switches that cannot be turned off over RPC.

proposals.description:
proposals are inert configuration drafts awaiting operator confirmation
(docs/llm-dev 16); they grant no execution authority.
